title: A member who renewed or came in at the desk can still get 'your plan ends' or 'we haven't seen you' reminders
what: The gym's automatic reminders are set on the phone days ahead, from the plan and last visit the phone knew when the app was last opened. The 15-minute background check does not refresh them. A member who renews at the desk, or is checked in by the desk, and does not open the app, still gets 'Your plan ends tomorrow', then 'Your plan ended on ...', or 'We haven't seen you for 14 days', while the admin app shows a paid renewal and a recent visit. The test gym has desk check-ins, so this mix is real.
expected: A reminder about the plan or visits matches what the gym's records say on the morning it shows, or is not shown.
how_often: whenever the app stays closed across a renewal or desk visit
fix_line: Re-plan the gym reminders in the background check, or check the plan again just before each plan or visit reminder shows

title: How busy the gym is can keep showing an old 'people in the last 90 minutes' count
what: The 30-minute 'too old' rule is applied only when the card first draws. If the Gym tab stays open, or the app comes back from the background on that tab, the card keeps the count it had, even hours later; offline it never hides.
expected: After 30 minutes without a fresh answer the card hides or says it is out of date, as it does when first opened.
how_often: when the Gym tab is left open or resumed
fix_line: Check the age of the busy answer on every minute tick and hide or refresh it after 30 minutes
